description: This file defines a template class 'OptionalType' which implements an optional value container for any type, including methods for assignment, comparison, and state checking. It is part of the 'WPEFramework::Core' namespace and provides functionality similar to std::optional.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: A template class that encapsulates an optional value of type 'TYPE', allowing it to be set, cleared, and compared.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for assigning from another OptionalType or a value of TYPE.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operators for comparing with a value of TYPE or another OptionalType.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison operators for comparing with a value of TYPE or another OptionalType.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks whether the optional contains a value.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the optional to an unset state.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Accessors to get the contained value, either mutable or const.
